components.label: Caller
components.responsibility: Invoke the documented API and retain returned outcomes.

components.label: Plan facade
components.responsibility: Append one immutable operation cell per map/filter; each terminal compiles the history into composite map-run functions and filter guards, then pushes source values through them in one loop.

components.label: Persistent history
components.responsibility: Link a new {previous,kind,fn} cell to the prior tail; never append into an array shared by branches.

components.label: Source snapshot
components.responsibility: Shallow-copy the source once; do not recopy on each intermediate call. Objects referenced by the copy are not deep frozen.

components.label: Composite compiler
components.responsibility: Map fusion: walk the history iteratively, reverse it, and turn each run of adjacent map cells into one composite function that loops over the run's callbacks in order. A filter always ends a run, so no callback moves across it, and no recursive closure nesting is built.

components.label: Push driver
components.responsibility: For each source item, call one composite per map run and one predicate per filter; a rejected item continues the outer source loop.

components.label: Output ordinal
components.responsibility: Increment output ordinal only after all filters pass; Object.is comparison returns immediately at the first match.

components.label: Exception boundary
components.responsibility: Use normal propagation through the terminal loop; discard the terminal-local accumulator and preserve the immutable plan.

components.label: Fresh traversal factory
components.responsibility: Create source and output counters per terminal; retain source snapshot and plan only, without caching results or sharing iteration state.

components.label: Caller
components.responsibility: Invoke the documented API and retain returned outcomes.

components.label: Cursor factory
components.responsibility: Retain immutable operator descriptors; open() builds one iterator object per operator run, each pulling from its upstream, and returns a guarded cursor with next() and close().

components.label: Descriptor spine
components.responsibility: Append a descriptor cell with a previous pointer; it describes an iterator layer and holds no live cursor.

components.label: Iterator chain builder
components.responsibility: open() flattens the descriptor spine iteratively, wraps a private source iterator with one MapRun or Filter iterator per run, innermost first, and hands the consumer only the outer layer.

components.label: Per-layer next()
components.responsibility: A filter iterator calls upstream.next() until its predicate accepts; a map-run iterator pulls once and applies its run; the outer layer returns one item.

components.label: Map-run iterator
components.responsibility: Adjacent map descriptors become one MapRun iterator whose next() calls a composite of the run's callbacks in order; a filter always starts a new iterator.

components.label: Pull search
components.responsibility: indexOf calls next until Object.is succeeds, then closes the cursor; close travels from the outer layer to the source, and no extra next call is made.

components.label: Close propagation
components.responsibility: close() marks each layer closed from the outside in and drops upstream references; next after close returns done, while another cursor or a new open() is unaffected.

components.label: Guarded collector
components.responsibility: The cursor's next() catches a callback exception, closes the whole chain and rethrows; collect drops its terminal-owned array, and a later next() returns done instead of resuming at the following element.

problem.scope: Authored implementation study of the catalogue LazyArray interface. Compare a plan that compiles each run of adjacent maps into one composite function driven by a single push loop with a pull chain of per-operator iterator objects. The catalogue's single composite function invocation is met as one composite call per element per adjacent-map run: it removes per-operator dispatch and intermediate arrays, while each user callback still runs once for every element that reaches it. No distributed components, implicit memoization or parallel evaluation. indexOf returns the index in the transformed, filtered output and uses Object.is equality; every terminal starts a fresh traversal.

evidence.testName: batch-07 lazy fused-plan: composite map runs, deferred branches and short circuit

acceptanceCases.given: A plan map, map, filter, map, map over a four-element source with logging callbacks, plus a branch that appends another filter.
acceptanceCases.then: No callback runs at construction; the branch leaves the base plan's stages unchanged; indexOf returns 1 without evaluating the fourth element; collect returns only the terminal output array.
acceptanceCases.when: Inspect the log after construction, collect the plan and the branch, then run indexOf for the second output.

evidence.testName: batch-07 lazy fused-plan: composite map runs, deferred branches and short circuit

acceptanceCases.given: The same map, map, filter, map, map plan with counted compiled stages.
acceptanceCases.then: Compilation yields a two-map composite, the filter and a second two-map composite; four elements cost 7 composite calls and 4 predicate calls instead of 14 per-map calls; callbacks still run in source order and the rejected element never reaches the later maps.
acceptanceCases.when: Compile the plan and collect it.

evidence.testName: batch-07 lazy fused-plan: composite map runs, deferred branches and short circuit

acceptanceCases.given: Empty input, a fully filtered plan, NaN and -0 targets, a throwing first map, and a caller push to the source array after construction.
acceptanceCases.then: Results are [] or -1; Object.is matches NaN and separates -0 from 0; a throw returns no partial array and later maps never run; a rerun calls every callback again; the caller's later push is invisible.
acceptanceCases.when: Run each terminal, then run it again.

guarantees: O(1) append; O(k) compilation per terminal; one composite call per element per map run; no source element after a hit is evaluated.

evidence.testName: batch-07 lazy cursors: per-operator iterator chain, close propagation and exception close

acceptanceCases.given: A source mapped twice, then branched with a filter and a map, and two cursors opened on the branch.
acceptanceCases.then: No callback runs at construction or open; the cursors advance independently; closing one closes its source after three pulls while the other continues; indexOf(6) returns 1 after exactly three calls of the first map.
acceptanceCases.when: Interleave next() on both cursors, close one, then run indexOf and collect.

evidence.testName: batch-07 lazy cursors: per-operator iterator chain, close propagation and exception close

acceptanceCases.when: Call next() again after the throw and run each terminal.
